BODY – INSTRUMENT PANEL

INSTRUMENT PANEL REMOVAL

1. REMOVE STEERING WHEEL
(See page SR–14)
CAUTION:
• When storing the wheel pad, keep the upper surface of the pad facing upward.
• Never disassemble the steering wheel pad.

[::] : 5 Clips
N06458

2. REMOVE THESE PARTS:
HINT: Tape a screwdriver tip before use.
(a) Front pillar garnishes
(b) Assist grip
(c) Foot rest
(d) Front door scuff inside plates
(e) Steering column cover
(f) Console upper panel

[::] : 3 Clips
N06712

(g) Parking brake hole cover
(h) Console box

[::] : 3 Clips
N81796

(i) Finish panel
(j) Finish lower LH panel

N09490

(k) Cluster finish panel
